finite_experiments.scope: Exhaustive low inputs, indexed shifts, horizontal residues and targets per scenario; both independent fibre orderings, both digits, negative coordinates, both signs of separated CRT lifts.

limits: No claim that the complete periodic-tiling theorem is formalized.
No global novelty or publishability verdict is supplied by Engineer.
Region/block charts and fibre orderings encode the manuscript's explicitly chosen labelled sets; activation bijectivity is proved, not assumed.
All permitted lifts are covered by the universal Lean theorem, not exhausted by finite tests.

manuscript_boundary_experiments.scope: Actual p>200, b_i>D, distinct prime seed data, prescribed seed-region residues, both block types, repeated shifts, extreme copies/labels and negative horizontal coordinates. This is not an enumeration of all D residues or the full ordinary-channel family.

mechanical_evidence.scope: Kernel-checked universal inverse theorem, not an inference from the finite experiments.
